system.description:
A mercenary from the free companies and caravan roads: mounted shooting, ambush tactics, and knowing when to run.

  • Mounted Dead Eye: Dead Eye applies even while you are mounted; the horse's movement doesn't break it.
    • 9th level: you may reload one blackpowder weapon during your mount's movement.
  • Field Operator: Advantage on checks to negotiate contracts, read terrain for ambush positions and identify tracks.
